Card Q&A.a: Place it on top of your security stack face down.
Card Q&A.q: I activate this card's effect to look at the top card of my security stack, and choose not to add it to my hand. What happens to that card?

Effect: [When Digivolving] Look at the top card of your security stack, and you may add it to your hand. If you do, ＜Recovery +1 (Deck)＞. (Place the top card of your deck on top of your security stack.)
